name: @feiyang666/dsh-mobile-remote
description: DeepSeek Harness remote-access plugin: LAN access that adapts to how dsh binds (loopback side-car listener, or directly reusing the `--host <nic>` listener that dsh already owns), external tunnel through a relay server with real reachability probing (502 detection), QR code / on-off toggle / remote-access password gate and device telemetry. No mobile UI patches: dsh 0.2.2+ ships its own responsive/mobile layout.
author: feiyang666 <1655093915@qq.com>

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/external.js && node --check lib/ws-client.js && node --check lib/password.js && node --check lib/patch.js && node --check lib/lanproxy.js && node --check lib/qrcode.js
